correctness.rationale: Exact XOR-wall formula directly proves that a non-all-one wall word erodes each maximal one-run by two per update until a fixed wall word. Cyclic XOR derivatives have even weight with two preimages; alternating all-one walls form the sole two-cycle. The run bound is sharp. The weighted finite transfer matrix recognizes all bounded-run cyclic words, and the determinant/traces identity proves the all-n rational generating function. The recurrence and standalone exhaustive tests through length 16 support reproducibility but are not substitutes for proof.
